rows.grounds: indeclinable compound expressing measure or capacity
object of the act of giving
compound: vāstu+site + yajña+sacrifice; object of completion
injunctive or optative sense prescribing ritual conclusion

items.question: What concluding action must follow offering an oblation in the site-sacrifice according to one's ability?
premises: An oblation is to be given according to one's ability.
The giving of the oblation precedes the final ritual act.
The site-sacrifice requires a prescribed completion.
items.inference: Therefore, after giving an oblation according to ability, one should complete the site-sacrifice.
items.plain_english: Having offered an oblation according to one's ability, one should complete the site-sacrifice.
